note: Alberta Parks campground on Chinook Lake, 8 km W of Coleman in Crowsnest Pass, in three treed loops: the two upper loops (A and B) hold the roomier RV sites, and the lower Loop C has some sites with partial lake views, with a strip of trees and the Lake Trail between them and the shore. Sites A80-A99 are tent-only. The hand pump is for putting out fires only; bring drinking water, and firewood bought locally. Non-motorized hand boat launch and a trail around the lake. --Claude
